THE SAMPLE WIDGETS ACT, 2099
An Act to provide for the registration of fictional widgets made from moonflower petals.
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title.—This Act may be called the Sample Widgets Act, 2099.
2. Definitions.—In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires,—
(a) "widget" means a fictional device crafted from moonflower petals;
(b) "registrar" means the fictional Registrar of Widgets.
CHAPTER II
REGISTRATION
3. Registration of widgets.—(1) Any person crafting a widget shall apply to the registrar for registration of the widget.
(2) The registrar shall examine the application under section 2 and may call for samples of moonflower petals.
1. Subs. by fictional Act 99 of 2100.
4. Renewal of registration.—A registration of a widget shall be renewed every seven moons on payment of a fictional fee of ten sea shells.
THE FIRST SCHEDULE
(See section 3)
1. Form of application for widget registration.
2. Particulars of moonflower petals used.
